name: Carousel Engine Pipeline
description: Genera carosello Instagram completo con stile glassmorphism premium

stages.name: Carousel Brief
actions: Parse user input: topic, target audience, key message, CTA
Map content to slide structure: Hook → Problem → Solution → Proof → CTA
Write exact text for each slide

stages.name: Slide Generation (Parallel)
actions: For each slide, load prompt template
Generate image via image generation tool
Apply style consistency rules from memory (palette, glassmorphism params)

stages.name: Visual Quality Review
actions: Review each slide against quality criteria
Check text legibility, style consistency, visual impact
Verify carousel flow (does slide sequence tell a story?)
Score each slide and calculate average

stages.name: Regenerate Weak Slides
actions: Regenerate only those slides with enhanced prompts
Preserve good slides (don't regenerate what works)

stages.name: Output + Memory Save
actions: Save all slide images to output/carousel-[timestamp]/
